summary: Milestone 2026.09.654 executed 10 experiments in 37.3 wall-time minutes, with all 10 designated compute-bound. bottlenecks_identified: 'Measure missing decision seams on adapter-withheld live ARC episodes' consumed 25.9 out of 37.3 minutes (over 69% of the milestone wall time), but intra-task timing is absent, leaving the exact bottlenecks within episode evaluation unknown.

The subsequent 9 compute-bound experiments completed in approximately 11.4 minutes combined (led by typed option energy prototyping at 4.26 minutes), with timestamps reconstructed from disk mtimes rather than active git commit logs.

The GPU monitor report provides an end-of-run snapshot showing 0% utilization and 4MB memory allocated after process completion, rather than continuous per-task telemetry during active compute windows.

improvements_suggested: Instrument sub-phase monotonic timestamps and episode progress logging within the ARC live evaluation harness to isolate inference from environment steps.
Record task-scoped GPU utilization and memory metrics sampled continuously across compute execution intervals.
Persist model cardinality and dispatch mechanism at job initiation, engaging DualGPURunner specifically when two or more models run concurrently.
Implement an early-stopping or bounded evaluation threshold for ARC episode observation when decision seams show negligible progression.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument fine-grained phase timers and episode iteration logging in live ARC episode evaluation.
Deploy continuous, task-aligned accelerator telemetry to sample GPU utilization during active execution spans.
Record model concurrency at launch and verify DualGPURunner dispatch for workloads running two or more models in parallel.
meta_reflection: The milestone critical path is clearly concentrated in the 25.9-minute live ARC seam observation task, but without phase-level telemetry, root-cause diagnosis remains unsubstantiated. A static post-run GPU snapshot cannot assess active compute-window efficiency, and absent model-count metadata prevents verifying DualGPURunner utilization.
